descriptionHtml:
Lenovo LOQ 15IAX9 Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i5-12600HX - RTX 3050 6GB - 16GB RAM

Step into high-performance gaming with the Lenovo LOQ 15IAX9 edition, proudly offered by Turbo Computer Egypt. Built inside a durable, military-grade Luna Grey chassis, this laptop features a powerful 12th Gen Intel Core i5-12600HX processor combined with 16GB of DDR5 system memory and dedicated NVIDIA RTX 3050 graphics. Complete with an advanced hyperchamber cooling solution for silent efficiency and a genuine Windows 11 Home architecture. Comes with an official 2-year agent warranty across Egypt.
